# AI Platform API Documentation

> AI Platform is a unified OpenAI-compatible API gateway for image and video generation. Base URL: the origin of this website. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>`. Most video and image tasks are async — create a task, then poll the query endpoint for status and results. Docs site: same as this website.

## Getting Started

- [Quickstart](/en/index.md): Get your API key, recharge your account, and send your first video generation request.
- [Development Guide](/en/development.md): Integration patterns and best practices for building with the AI Platform API.
- [快速入门](/zh/index.md): 获取 API 密钥、充值账户并发送首个视频生成请求。
- [开发指南](/zh/development.md): 在应用程序中集成 AI Platform API 的指南。

## FAQ

- [FAQ](/en/faq.md): Frequently asked questions about billing, authentication, and API usage.
- [常见问题](/zh/faq.md): 有关计费、认证和 API 使用的常见问题解答。

## API Reference

- [Introduction](/en/api-reference/introduction.md): Overview of AI Platform API capabilities — Sora, VEO, Gemini Omni, Seedance, and GPT Image models.
- [介绍](/zh/api-reference/introduction.md): AI Platform API 能力概览 — Sora、VEO、Gemini Omni、Seedance 及 GPT Image 模型。

### Common

- [Query Video Task](/en/api-reference/common/query.md): Query the status and result of a video generation task.
- [Query Image Task](/en/api-reference/images/query.md): Query the status and result of an image generation task.
- [Query SoundClone Task](/en/api-reference/common/sound-clone-query.md): Poll SoundClone task status via GET /audios/{id}.
- [查询视频任务](/zh/api-reference/common/query.md): 查询视频生成任务的状态和结果。
- [查询图片任务](/zh/api-reference/images/query.md): 查询图片生成任务的状态和结果。
- [查询声音克隆任务](/zh/api-reference/common/sound-clone-query.md): 查询 SoundClone 任务状态与 audioUrl。

### Account Management

- [Query User Account Balance](/en/api-reference/common/user-balance.md): GET /user/balance — points account balance for the API key owner.
- [Query API Key Quota Balance](/en/api-reference/common/key-balance.md): GET /key/balance — per-key usage quota.
- [查询用户账户余额](/zh/api-reference/common/user-balance.md): GET /user/balance — 查询 API Key 所属用户的积分账户余额。
- [查询 API Key 额度余额](/zh/api-reference/common/key-balance.md): GET /key/balance — 查询当前 Key 的调用额度。

### Sora Video

- [Create Video](/en/api-reference/videos/create.md): Create a video generation task using Sora models (route1, route3, route6).
- [创建视频](/zh/api-reference/videos/create.md): 使用 Sora 模型创建视频生成任务。

### Gemini Omni Video

- [Create Gemini Omni Video](/en/api-reference/gemini-omni/create.md): Create a Gemini Omni video generation task; poll the common query endpoint for results.
- [创建 Gemini Omni 视频](/zh/api-reference/gemini-omni/create.md): 创建 Gemini Omni 视频生成任务，通过通用查询接口获取结果。

### MiniMax Video

- [Create Seedance 2.5 Video](/en/api-reference/seedance/25/create.md): Create a Seedance 2.5 video task (reference images/videos/audios); billed per_second; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 Seedance 2.5 视频](/zh/api-reference/seedance/25/create.md): 创建 Seedance 2.5 视频任务（参考图/视频/音频），按秒计费，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [Create Seedance 2.5 GZ Video](/en/api-reference/seedance/25/create-gz.md): Create a Seedance 2.5 GZ video task; precharged then settled to actual usage; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 Seedance 2.5 GZ 视频](/zh/api-reference/seedance/25/create-gz.md): 创建 Seedance 2.5 GZ 视频任务，创建时预扣、成功后按实际用量多退少补，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [seedance2.5-md](/en/api-reference/seedance/25/create-ar.md): Create a fixed 15-second Seedance 2.5 MD video; billed per task.
- [seedance2.5-md](/zh/api-reference/seedance/25/create-ar.md): 创建固定 15 秒的 Seedance 2.5 MD 视频，按次计费。
- [seedance2.5-30s](/en/api-reference/seedance/25/create-30s.md): Create a fixed 30-second Seedance 2.5 video (up to 30 images, 10 videos, 10 audios); billed per task.
- [seedance2.5-30s](/zh/api-reference/seedance/25/create-30s.md): 创建固定 30 秒的 Seedance 2.5 视频（最多 30 张图、10 个视频、10 段音频），按次计费。
- [sd2.5-720p](/en/api-reference/seedance/25/create-sd25-720p.md): Create a 720p video (4–30 seconds) that keeps faces; billed per second on `sd2.5-720p`.
- [sd2.5-720p](/zh/api-reference/seedance/25/create-sd25-720p.md): 创建 720p 视频（4–30 秒），参考图不卡脸，按独立型号 `sd2.5-720p` 按秒计费。
- [sd2.5-720p-ac](/en/api-reference/seedance/25/create-sd25-720p-ac.md): Create a 720p video (4–30 seconds, up to 30 images, 10 videos, 10 audios) that keeps faces; billed per task on `sd2.5-720p-ac`.
- [sd2.5-720p-ac](/zh/api-reference/seedance/25/create-sd25-720p-ac.md): 创建 720p 视频（4–30 秒，最多 30 张图、10 个参考视频、10 个参考音频），参考图不卡脸，按独立型号 `sd2.5-720p-ac` 按次计费。
- [Create MiniMax H3 Video](/en/api-reference/minimax/create.md): Create a MiniMax H3 video task (reference images/audio, first/last frame); billed per_task; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 MiniMax H3 视频](/zh/api-reference/minimax/create.md): 创建 MiniMax H3 视频任务（参考图/音频、首尾帧），按次计费，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [Create Wan 3.0 Video](/en/api-reference/wan/create.md): Create a Wan 3.0 (`wan3.0`) video task (reference images/videos/audios); billed per_second by resolution; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 Wan 3.0 视频](/zh/api-reference/wan/create.md): 创建 Wan 3.0（`wan3.0`）视频任务（参考图/视频/音频），按分辨率按秒计费，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [Create Wan 3.0 GZ Video](/en/api-reference/wan/create-gz.md): Create a Wan 3.0 GZ (`wan3.0-gz`) video task (2–30s, adaptive ratio, first/last frame, reference images/videos/audios, reference document or webpage); billed per_second via `wan3.0-gz-{resolution}`; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 Wan 3.0 GZ 视频](/zh/api-reference/wan/create-gz.md): 创建 Wan 3.0 GZ（`wan3.0-gz`）视频任务（2–30 秒、自适应画幅、首尾帧、参考图/视频/音频、参考文件或网页），按 `wan3.0-gz-{分辨率}` 按秒计费，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [Create Seedance 2.0 GZ Video](/en/api-reference/seedance/gz720/create.md): Create a Seedance 2.0 GZ video task (`seedance2.0-gz*`; asset review; direct result URL); billed per_million_tokens; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建 Seedance 2.0 GZ 视频](/zh/api-reference/seedance/gz720/create.md): 创建 Seedance 2.0 GZ 视频任务（`seedance2.0-gz*`；素材审核；结果为上游直链），按百万 token 计费，通过通用查询接口获取结果。
- [Create Official Mini Video](/en/api-reference/seedance/mini/create-gz.md): Create an Official Mini video task (`seedance2.0-gz-mini*`; asset review; direct result URL); billed per_second; poll the common query endpoint.
- [创建官链 Mini 视频](/zh/api-reference/seedance/mini/create-gz.md): 创建官链 Mini 视频任务（`seedance2.0-gz-mini*`；素材审核；结果为上游直链），按秒计费，通过通用查询接口获取结果。

### LLM

- [Chat Completions](/en/api-reference/chat/completions.md): OpenAI-compatible LLM chat (`gpt-5.6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-terra`, `claude-sonnet-5`); pay-as-you-go token billing with cache read/write breakdown.
- [Chat Completions](/zh/api-reference/chat/completions.md): 兼容 OpenAI 的 LLM 对话（`gpt-5.6-sol`、`gpt-5.6-terra`、`claude-sonnet-5`）；按 token 计费，支持缓存读/写分段。
- [Probe model pricing](/en/api-reference/common/model-catalog.md): Public model catalog including `llm` billing models.



### Image Services

- [GPT Image 2 Image Generation](/en/api-reference/images/create.md): Create an async GPT Image 2 image task.
- [Seedream 5.0 Pro](/en/api-reference/images/seedream-5-0-pro/create.md): Async Seedream 5.0 Pro image generation (1K/2K, single image per request).
- [GPT Image 2 Text-to-Image](/en/api-reference/images/generations.md): Sync text-to-image, OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/images/generations.
- [GPT Image 2 Edit Image](/en/api-reference/images/edits.md): Sync image editing, OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/images/edits with multipart/form-data.
- [Understand Image](/en/api-reference/images/understand.md): Image understanding and analysis powered by Gemini.
- [GPT Image 2 图像生成](/zh/api-reference/images/create.md): 创建 GPT Image 2 异步图片生成任务。
- [Seedream 5.0 Pro 图像生成](/zh/api-reference/images/seedream-5-0-pro/create.md): Seedream 5.0 Pro 异步生图（1K/2K，每次 1 张）。
- [GPT Image 2 文生图](/zh/api-reference/images/generations.md): 同步文生图，兼容 OpenAI POST /v1/images/generations。
- [GPT Image 2 编辑图片](/zh/api-reference/images/edits.md): 同步图片编辑，兼容 OpenAI POST /v1/images/edits。
- [图片理解](/zh/api-reference/images/understand.md): 基于 Gemini 的图片理解与分析。

- [Create VEO Video](/en/api-reference/veo/create-frames.md): Create a VEO video task.
- [创建 VEO 视频](/zh/api-reference/veo/create-frames.md): 创建 VEO 视频任务。

### Seedance Full Video

- [Create Seedance Full Video](/en/api-reference/seedance/create.md): Create a Full (Manxue) Seedance video task.
- [Submit Assets for Audit](/en/api-reference/seedance/assets-audit.md): Submit asset URLs for Seedance platform audit before use in video generation.
- [Query Assets Audit Status](/en/api-reference/seedance/assets-status.md): Query the audit status of submitted assets.
- [创建 Seedance 满血版视频](/zh/api-reference/seedance/create.md): 创建 Seedance 满血版视频生成任务。
- [提交素材审核](/zh/api-reference/seedance/assets-audit.md): 提交素材 URL 进行 Seedance 平台审核。
- [查询素材审核状态](/zh/api-reference/seedance/assets-status.md): 查询已提交素材的审核状态。

### Seedance 2.0 Video (Mini)

- [Mini Create Video](/en/api-reference/seedance/mini/create.md): Create a Seedance 2.0 Mini video task (per-second billing by resolution).
- [Mini 创建视频](/zh/api-reference/seedance/mini/create.md): 创建 Seedance 2.0 Mini 视频任务（按分辨率按秒计费）。

### Seedance SP Economy

- [SP Create Video](/en/api-reference/seedance/sp/create.md): Create a Seedance SP video task (economy or official).
- [SP Upload Asset](/en/api-reference/seedance/sp/assets-upload.md): Upload assets to the SP economy library.
- [SP Query Asset Detail](/en/api-reference/seedance/sp/assets-detail.md): Query a single SP asset status.
- [SP Batch Query Asset Status](/en/api-reference/seedance/sp/assets-status.md): Batch query SP asset status.
- [SP Submit Real-Person Whitelist](/en/api-reference/seedance/sp/realperson-submit.md): Submit real-person portrait for whitelist processing.
- [SP Query Real-Person Status](/en/api-reference/seedance/sp/realperson-status.md): Query real-person whitelist status.
- [SP 创建视频](/zh/api-reference/seedance/sp/create.md): 创建 Seedance SP 视频任务（经济版 / 官方版）。
- [SP 上传素材](/zh/api-reference/seedance/sp/assets-upload.md): 上传素材到 SP 经济版素材库。
- [SP 查询素材详情](/zh/api-reference/seedance/sp/assets-detail.md): 查询单个 SP 素材状态。
- [SP 批量查询素材状态](/zh/api-reference/seedance/sp/assets-status.md): 批量查询 SP 素材状态。
- [SP 提交真人加白](/zh/api-reference/seedance/sp/realperson-submit.md): 提交真人图片进行加白处理。
- [SP 查询真人加白状态](/zh/api-reference/seedance/sp/realperson-status.md): 查询真人加白处理状态。

### Seedance MD

- [MD Create Video](/en/api-reference/seedance/md/create.md): Create a Seedance MD video task.
- [MD 创建视频](/zh/api-reference/seedance/md/create.md): 创建 Seedance MD 视频任务。

### SoundClone

- [Create Preview Task](/en/api-reference/sound-clone/clone-create.md): Submit voice-cloning preview from source audio/video URL.
- [Create Audio Task](/en/api-reference/sound-clone/audio-create.md): Generate production audio with modelId; billed per 10k characters plus voice fee on every submission.
- [提交试听任务](/zh/api-reference/sound-clone/clone-create.md): 提交声音克隆试听任务。
- [提交音频生成任务](/zh/api-reference/sound-clone/audio-create.md): 使用 modelId 生成正式音频，每次按字符 + 音色（按次）计费。

### Tools

- [Create Video Super-Resolution](/en/api-reference/super-resolution/create.md): Enhance a public video to higher resolution/FPS; poll common video query.
- [创建视频超分任务](/zh/api-reference/super-resolution/create.md): 将公网视频增强为更高清结果，通过通用视频查询接口轮询。
- [Create Remove-Subtitle Task](/en/api-reference/remove-subtitle/create.md): Remove burned-in subtitles from a public video; poll common video query.
- [创建去字幕任务](/zh/api-reference/remove-subtitle/create.md): 去除公网视频画面字幕，通过通用视频查询接口轮询。
- [Create Video-Translate Task](/en/api-reference/video-translate/create.md): Translate spoken video into a target language; poll common video query; optional caption_url.
- [创建视频翻译任务](/zh/api-reference/video-translate/create.md): 将源视频口播翻译到目标语言，通过通用视频查询接口轮询；可选 caption_url。
